## PR Checklist

- [ ] PR title adheres to Conventional Commits (`feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, `test(...)`, `docs(...)`, etc.)
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally (lint, format:check, typecheck, test:unit, test:integration)
- [ ] Tests added or updated covering the new or modified behaviour
- [ ] No `console.log` or debug statements left behind (except dedicated loggers)
- [ ] No commented-out code
- [ ] No new environment variables added without updating `.env.example`, `lib/env.ts`, and documentation
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`, `architecture.md`, `STATUS.md` where applicable)
- [ ] No new dependencies added without explicit architectural justification
- [ ] Migration added is backward-compatible for one release (if database touched)
